paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Ablation studies on n-best candidates generations (Beam search and Sampling search) on valid set of WMT15 De-En.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for three different methods: Inconsistency-CE, Consistency-Bi + sampling, and Consistency-Bi + beam. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", is linear and spans from 2.5 to 12.5, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", is linear and ranges from 24 to 31, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The "Inconsistency-CE" method is represented by a blue line with circular markers, starting at a BLEU score of 24.0 at AL=2.5 and rising to 29.9 at AL=12.5. The "Consistency-Bi + sampling" method is shown as an orange line with triangle markers, beginning at approximately 27.8 at AL=2.5 and increasing to 30.9 at AL=12.5. The "Consistency-Bi + beam" method is depicted by a green line with square markers, starting at approximately 27.8 at AL=2.5 and reaching 30.9 at AL=12.5. All three lines show an upward trend as AL increases, with the blue line starting lower and the orange and green lines starting at similar values and ending at similar values.
